app.name: ReadyFile Desk
app.prototype: Prototype with fictional data. Not an official court site.

list.title: Online petitions

introTotal.zero: Since the counter closed Friday at 4 pm, no stalking or harassment petitions came in online.
introTotal.one: Since the counter closed Friday at 4 pm, 1 stalking or harassment petition came in online.
introTotal.other: Since the counter closed Friday at 4 pm, {total} stalking and harassment petitions came in online.

introQuestions.zero: None have questions the counter would ask.
introQuestions.one: 1 has questions the counter would ask.
introQuestions.other: {withQuestions} have questions the counter would ask.

list.filterNote: Desk checks stalking and harassment petitions. Domestic violence petitions go straight to review until those rules are written.
list.noPhoneNote: The question goes to review with the petition.
notes: Desk runs the same checks as ReadyFile on every online stalking and harassment petition. Each question traces to one rule and its source.
Nothing waits unless staff hold it. A hold lasts up to 24 hours. Then the petition goes to the magistrate, answered or not.
Flags show what the petitioner reported. They never reorder or hide a petition.

hold.label: Hold
hold.notHeldBody: It's in the magistrate's review queue now. Holding it gives the petitioner up to 24 hours to answer.
hold.noPhone: No phone number, so there's no one to follow up with.
hold.heldBody: You held it at {time} {weekday}. It goes to the magistrate then, answered or not.
hold.heldBodyAsked: The hold started at {time} {weekday}. It goes to the magistrate then, answered or not.
hold.askedBy: The magistrate asked for follow-up at {time}.
hold.sentBody: Sent at {time}. The hold has ended.

timeline.label: Hold timeline
timeline.ifHeld: If you hold it now: until {time}

sentences.noOverlapTexts: The petitioner's call times don't overlap the counter's hours. A text link lets the petitioner add details before the hold ends.
sentences.noOverlapNoTexts: The petitioner's call times don't overlap the counter's hours, and the petitioner asked not to get texts.
sentences.overlap: The petitioner's call times overlap the counter's hours from {start} to {end}.
sentences.noCallTimes: The petition gives no call times.

alt.ifHeld: A hold started now would last until {time}.

title.zero: No questions the counter would ask

questions.none: Desk found no questions in this petition.

infoBox.title: Keep it to information
infoBox.information: Stalking is defined as two or more incidents. Are there other times you want to describe?
infoBox.test: The test: information tells the petitioner what the law says. Advice tells the petitioner what to do.

adviceExamples: This will be denied as it is.

filed.title: Petition as filed
filed.splitNote: Incidents are split by paragraph and date phrases, the same way ReadyFile splits them.

contactPanel.title: Contact
contactPanel.messageTemplate: Hi, this is Allen County staff about the form you sent on {filedWeekday}. You can add more details here until {untilWeekday} {untilTime}: [link]. Reply STOP to end texts.
contactPanel.messageNote: Neutral wording. It never names the case type or the other person.
contactPanel.beforeHold: Hold the petition to follow up.
contactPanel.texted: Link texted at {time}. Not opened yet.
contactPanel.textedAdded: Link texted at {time}. The petitioner added details at {added}.
contactPanel.noTexts: The petitioner asked not to get texts.
contactPanel.outsideCallTimes: It's outside the petitioner's call times.

checked.zero: Desk checked the petition and found no questions.
checked.one: Desk checked the petition and found 1 question.
checked.other: Desk checked the petition and found {n} questions.

log.held: T. Reyes held the petition for follow-up until {until}.
log.asked: The magistrate asked the specialist to follow up. The petition is held until {until}.
log.texted: T. Reyes texted the link to the petitioner.

amended.zero: The petitioner filed an amended petition.
amended.one: The petitioner filed an amended petition that adds 1 incident.
amended.other: The petitioner filed an amended petition that adds {n} incidents.

log.sent: T. Reyes sent the petition to the magistrate.
log.holdEnded: The hold ended, and the petition went to the magistrate.

review.title: Ex parte review
review.intro: Petitions waiting for your review, oldest first.
review.empty: No petitions are waiting for review.

bench.caption: {petitioner} v. {respondent}
bench.queueSince: In your review queue since {weekday} at {time}.
bench.previewNote: Preview. This is what the magistrate sees when the petition reaches review.
bench.builtFrom: Built from the {version} petition. The petitioner's words are unchanged and sorted by date. Desk doesn't judge whether the petition meets any legal standard.
bench.noEdit: Staff can't edit petition text in Desk. Every word above is the petitioner's.

outcome.title: Record the outcome
outcome.intro: Enter your order as usual. Recording the outcome here shows the court why online petitions are denied.
outcome.told: What the petitioner will be told
outcome.toldNone: Pick an outcome to see what the petitioner will be told.
outcome.toldGranted: If the petitioner signed up for notices, the court's usual notices go out when the order is granted and served.
outcome.toldHearing: The petitioner gets the hearing date and time.
outcome.toldDenied: The petitioner gets a new denial notice: your reason in plain words and the options available, in wording the court approves. No such notice exists today.
outcome.pickReason: Pick at least one reason, or Other.
outcome.saved: Saved as {outcome}. Your order is still entered as usual.

openQuestions.ask: Ask the specialist to follow up
openQuestions.asked: Sent to T. Reyes. It comes back to you within 24 hours.
openQuestions.noPhone: No phone number, so there's no one to follow up with.
openQuestions.alreadyHeld: This petition already had its 24-hour hold.

demo.title: Demo controls
demo.note: Development only. These controls don't appear in a real build.
demo.addIncidents: Petitioner adds incidents through the link
demo.jumpEnd: Jump to the end of the hold

flags.note: Flags show what the petitioner reported. They never reorder or hide a petition.
flags.answersIntro: The petitioner's own answers to the optional safety questions. Desk doesn't score or judge them.
